name: inventory-pet-icons-fusion
description: Verify every pet Inventory card uses its own model-matched preview and the visible FUSE action obeys server-authoritative duplicate, lock, and max-star rules.

steps.label: wait for Inventory and pet builders

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild('PunchWallAutomation') a:Invoke('Reset') local s=a:Invoke('SetStats',{PetInventoryJSON='["Forest Pup","Forest Pup","Miner Cat","Crystal Fox","Lava Dragon","Secret Titan Golem"]',EquippedPetsJSON='[]',LockedPetsJSON='[]',DiscoveredPetsJSON='["Forest Pup","Miner Cat","Crystal Fox","Lava Dragon","Secret Titan Golem"]'}) return H:JSONEncode({ok=s.ok==true,inventory=s.PetInventoryJSON})

steps.label: seed five distinct normal pet species with fusion copies

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') a:Invoke('OpenInventory') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Pets') a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','') a:Invoke('SetInventoryRarity','All') a:Invoke('RequestAction',{action='RequestSync'}) task.wait(.8) local r=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory local grid=r.InventoryWindow.InventoryBody.InventoryGridPane.InventoryGrid local names={} local ready=0 local cards=0 for _,card in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do if card:IsA('GuiObject') and card.Visible and card:GetAttribute('InventoryCategory')=='Pets' then cards+=1 local n=card:GetAttribute('PreviewPetName') names[n]=true local vp=card:FindFirstChild('ItemPetPreview',true) local model=vp and vp:FindFirstChild('PetPreviewWorld') and vp.PetPreviewWorld:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model') if card:GetAttribute('ArtMode')=='ModelMatchedViewportV1' and vp and vp.Visible and vp:GetAttribute('PreviewReady')==true and vp:GetAttribute('PreviewPetName')==n and model and model:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName')==n then ready+=1 end end end local unique=0 for _ in pairs(names) do unique+=1 end a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem','pet:slot:1') task.wait(.35) local fuse=r:FindFirstChild('Actionfuse',true) local detail=r:FindFirstChild('DetailArtFrame',true) local detailVp=detail and detail:FindFirstChild('DetailPetPreview') local ok=cards==6 and ready==6 and unique==5 and names['Forest Pup'] and names['Miner Cat'] and names['Crystal Fox'] and names['Lava Dragon'] and names['Secret Titan Golem'] and r:GetAttribute('InventoryActiveActionCount')==4 and r:GetAttribute('InventoryWideActionColumns')==2 and fuse and fuse.Visible and fuse.Active and fuse:GetAttribute('InventoryAction')=='Fuse' and fuse:GetAttribute('InventoryActionStyle')=='Fusion' and detail:GetAttribute('ArtMode')=='ModelMatchedViewportV1' and detailVp and detailVp.Visible and detailVp:GetAttribute('PreviewPetName')=='Forest Pup' return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,cards=cards,ready=ready,unique=unique,actions=r:GetAttribute('InventoryActiveActionCount'),columns=r:GetAttribute('InventoryWideActionColumns'),fuse=fuse and fuse.Text,fuseActive=fuse and fuse.Active,fuseStyle=fuse and fuse:GetAttribute('InventoryActionStyle'),detailPet=detailVp and detailVp:GetAttribute('PreviewPetName')})

steps.label: all cards and detail use distinct model-matched previews with balanced Fusion action
capture model-matched pet Inventory and Fusion button

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD.PunchWallClientAutomation local ok,reason=a:Invoke('InvokeInventoryAction',{key='pet:slot:1',action='Fuse'}) return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok==true,reason=reason})

steps.label: press visible Fusion action through Inventory controller

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local deadline=os.clock()+2.5 local value repeat value=p.RPGStats.PetInventoryJSON.Value if value:find('Forest Pup#2',1,true) then break end task.wait(.05) until os.clock()>=deadline local decoded=H:JSONDecode(value) local names={} for _,token in ipairs(decoded) do names[token]=(names[token] or 0)+1 end local ok=#decoded==5 and names['Forest Pup#2']==1 and names['Forest Pup']==nil and names['Miner Cat']==1 and names['Crystal Fox']==1 and names['Lava Dragon']==1 and names['Secret Titan Golem']==1 return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,count=#decoded,forest2=names['Forest Pup#2'] or 0,forest1=names['Forest Pup'] or 0,inventory=value})

steps.label: server consumes exactly two unlocked copies and creates one two-star pet

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('RequestAction',{action='RequestSync'}) task.wait(.5) a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Pets') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem','pet:slot:5') task.wait(.2) local s=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') local ok,reason=a:Invoke('InvokeInventoryAction',{key='pet:slot:5',action='Fuse'}) local selected=s.selected or {} return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok==false and reason=='action_unavailable' and selected.name=='Forest Pup' and selected.fusionRequired==3 and selected.fusionOwned==1 and selected.fusionEnabled==false,reason=reason,name=selected.name,required=selected.fusionRequired,owned=selected.fusionOwned,enabled=selected.fusionEnabled})

steps.label: Fusion stays disabled when the next-star duplicate requirement is not met

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local s=a:Invoke('SetStats',{PetInventoryJSON='["Forest Pup#5"]',EquippedPetsJSON='[]',LockedPetsJSON='[]'}) return H:JSONEncode({ok=s.ok==true,inventory=s.PetInventoryJSON})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('RequestAction',{action='RequestSync'}) task.wait(.45) a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Pets') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem','pet:slot:1') task.wait(.2) local s=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') local selected=s.selected or {} local fuse=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory:FindFirstChild('Actionfuse',true) return H:JSONEncode({ok=selected.fusionEnabled==false and selected.fusionRequired==0 and fuse and fuse.Text=='MAX STAR' and fuse.Active==false,label=fuse and fuse.Text,active=fuse and fuse.Active,required=selected.fusionRequired})

steps.label: max-star pet exposes a clear disabled boundary instead of dispatching
